parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the call center.

parameters.name: RamIds
parameters.description:
The collection of RAM IDs.

If no data is specified, the device information of the current agent is queried. Separate multiple RAM IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Default value: 00:00 of the current day.

parameters.name: StopTime
parameters.description: The end time. Default value: the current time.
